title: Playboy Magazine August 1975 Lillian Muller Cover Girl Playmate Vintage
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, August 1975 issue, featuring Lillian Muller as Cover Girl Playmate.
Inside: fiction by John Updike, an exposé on the CIA from ex-agent Philip Agee, "Federal Justice — Prosecution or Inquisition?", a look at female escort services, a pictorial fantasy "After Hours in a Department Store," and the pro football forecast.
Complete issue, no missing pages noted. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
